decision.summary: Learned fusion beats affine cross-city by 44% (MAE 2.50 vs 4.43 m), cross-city RMSE 4.67 m (ABOVE the 2-4 m reference band), generalization gap acceptable. Proceed to build the full pipeline around this swappable height head.

criteria.name: depth_prior_has_signal
criteria.note: Baseline A Pearson r vs nDSM. Near-zero => no monotone height signal; calibration/learning cannot rescue it.

criteria.name: learned_beats_affine_xcity
criteria.note: Relative cross-city MAE reduction of C over B. THE central test: if <=0, the learned head adds nothing over trivial calibration.

criteria.name: learned_ok_indomain
criteria.note: C in-domain MAE <= B in-domain MAE (did the head fit at all?).

criteria.name: xcity_rmse_in_reference_band
criteria.note: Cross-city RMSE vs the 2-4 m reference band (shadow ref ~3.84 m). CONTEXT, not a hard target.

criteria.name: gen_gap_not_catastrophic
criteria.note: Cross-city MAE / in-domain MAE. Large => overfits the train city.

criteria.name: building_signal_xcity
criteria.note: C cross-city building-only Pearson r (buildings are the hard class).

decision.human_note: These criteria are decision AIDS derived from signal sanity checks and the user-supplied reference points (2-4 m RMSE band; ~3.84 m shadow reference). They are editable (DecisionThresholds) and are NOT authoritative pass/fail targets. A human reviewer makes the final GO/MODIFY/ABANDON call using these measured numbers plus qualitative inspection of the error maps.
